Adani Power.summary: Both captured houses are bullish, but there is effectively only one *current* view: **Jefferies** (May-2026, Buy, PT ₹255) on the FCF-turnaround and capacity build-out. Asit C Mehta's positive note is a year old (May-2025) and thematic, so it adds little to today's debate. Net: a one-broker bull case with no live bear to weigh against — read the absence of fresh sell-side scrutiny as a reason for caution, not comfort.

Jeff|260518.change: Maintained Buy; PT held at ₹255. Thesis recentred on FCF turning positive by FY30E and falling leverage.
Jeff|260518.view: The most credible bull case on the name and recently refreshed — but a single covering house means limited triangulation; I'd want a second major broker before leaning on consensus.

Asit|250521.change: Dated May-2025 thematic note — nothing recent to compare against.
Asit|250521.view: A year-old positive piece; treat as stale. The live read on Adani Power is essentially Jefferies' alone.

Apollo Hospitals.summary: Near-unanimous bullish after a strong 4QFY26, and importantly the three *freshest* houses all RAISED targets on the print — **Jefferies** ₹9,250→₹9,700, **Kotak** ₹8,980→₹9,520, **CLSA** to ₹9,280 — clustering tightly around ₹9,300–9,700. The only cautious voice, **ICICI Securities** ('soft quarter, bed addition critical', Nov-2025), pre-dates the beat and now looks stale, as do Geojit/ICICI Direct's older ₹7,763–8,840 targets that the stock has since outrun. So this is a converged, upgraded consensus with no current bear — the genuine debate is execution on the new-hospital ramp and the HealthCo listing, not direction.

CLSA|260522.change: Maintained Outperform; PT ₹9,280 after the 4QFY26 beat.
CLSA|260522.view: In line with the pack; the post-results raise is incremental, not a new thesis.

Kotak|260522.change: Maintained Buy; PT raised ₹8,980→₹9,520 on rapid bed additions and better HealthCo/diagnostics margins.
Kotak|260522.view: Fair — the raise is earnings-led, but Kotak itself stays cautious on 24/7, which I'd echo.

PL|260522.change: Q4FY26 update; Buy retained (PT not parsed).

Jeff|260521.change: Maintained Buy; PT raised ₹9,250→₹9,700; FY27-28 EBITDA estimates +5%.
Jeff|260521.view: Top of the PT range; leans on the HealthCo value-unlock, which I'd treat as optionality rather than banked.

MO|260211.change: Feb-2026 note (pre-4QFY26); bullish on hospital optimisation + HealthCo traction.
MO|260211.view: Directionally right but stale — superseded by the post-Q4 upgrades above.

Geojit|251219.change: Dec-2025: upgraded to Buy, PT ₹7,763 — now well below the stock; dated.
Geojit|251219.view: Target has been overtaken by events; ignore the level, the call was early-correct.

ICICI|251109.change: Nov-2025: cautious ('soft quarter; bed addition critical to revive growth').
ICICI|251109.view: The lone bear, but it pre-dates the strong 4QFY26 — its core worry (new-bed execution) is still the right thing to watch even if the timing call was wrong.

ICICI|251107.change: Nov-2025: upgraded to Buy, PT ₹8,840; dated.
ICICI|251107.view: Superseded; useful only as evidence the buy-side turned positive early.

Sun Pharmaceuticals.summary: The one genuinely *split* book here. **Bernstein** is the bull (Outperform, PT ₹2,235) on the under-appreciated US innovation arm; **Kotak** is constructive (Add, PT raised ₹1,850→₹1,960). Against them, **CLSA** (Hold, ₹2,020) and **Jefferies** are neutral, and **JPMorgan** is the bear, flagging the 4QFY26 EBITDA/PAT miss (~11–13% below consensus). The fault line is clear: optimism on the specialty re-rating (Bernstein/Kotak) versus caution on near-term earnings quality and US compliance/pricing (JPMorgan/CLSA/Jefferies). I'd weight the sceptics slightly more — the bull case rests on pipeline/label catalysts not yet delivered, while the miss and Halol risk are concrete.

Bern|260525.change: Maintained Outperform; PT held ₹2,235. Doubles down on innovation arm as 'most underappreciated'.
Bern|260525.view: The most bullish and most thesis-driven view; compelling if specialty delivers, but it's talking its book on a re-rating that hasn't happened yet.

CLSA|260524.change: Hold; PT ₹2,020. India/other regions offsetting tepid US generics.
CLSA|260524.view: A sensible fence-sitter — captures the real tension (strong India, soft US) better than either extreme.

JP|260524.change: Bearish; flags 4QFY26 EBITDA/PAT ~11–13% below consensus on higher costs.
JP|260524.view: The most useful counterweight — earnings quality and the miss are concrete, not narrative. I'd take this seriously against the bull case.

Kotak|260524.change: Maintained Add; PT raised ₹1,850→₹1,960 despite muted Global Innovative Medicines sales.
Kotak|260524.view: Constructive but measured; the PT raise sits well below Bernstein's, which tells you even the bulls disagree on magnitude.

Jeff|260522.change: Neutral; broadly in-line quarter (India formulations solid).
Jeff|260522.view: Adds to the cautious cluster — three of five houses are neutral-to-negative, which is the real message here.
